function buildBundlesFromResults(results,s,useConsensus=false){
 const bestRes=results.find(x=>x.src.id==="best");
 const pick=useConsensus?consensusRow:row;
 return s.samples.map((p,i)=>{
   const forecasts=MODELS.map(md=>pick(results.find(x=>x.src.id===md.id),i,p,s));
   const best=pick(bestRes,i,p,s);
   return {p,forecasts,best,conf:confidence(forecasts,s.date)};
 });
}
function renderTimelineFromBundles(bundles,s){
 const stillLoading=anyDeterministicPending(s);
 document.getElementById("timeline").innerHTML=bundles.map(b=>{
    const rs=b.forecasts.filter(Boolean), disp=rs[0]||b.best;
    if(!disp){
      const status=stillLoading?"Loading forecast…":"Forecast not yet in range";
      return `<div class="stop"><div class="stopPlace">${b.p.label==="Start"?s.start:b.p.label==="Finish"?s.finish:b.p.label}</div><div class="stopMeta">${b.p.km} km · ${b.p.ele} m · ~${rideClock(b.p.ride_h,s,b.p.km)}</div><div class="risk">${status}</div></div>`;
    }
    const temps=rs.map(x=>x.temp).filter(Number.isFinite), meanT=temps.length?Math.round(temps.reduce((a,c)=>a+c,0)/temps.length):Math.round(disp.temp);
    const wetN=rs.filter(wet).length, code=rs.some(x=>x.code>=95)?95:wetN?80:disp.code;
    const prob=b.best?.rain;
    const winds=rs.map(x=>x.wind).filter(Number.isFinite);
    const gusts=rs.map(x=>x.gust).filter(Number.isFinite);
    const wind=Math.round(winds.length?winds.reduce((a,c)=>a+c,0)/winds.length:0);
    const gust=Math.round(gusts.length?gusts.reduce((a,c)=>a+c,0)/gusts.length:0);
    const cond=rs.some(x=>x.code>=95)?"Thunder":wetN>=2?"Rain/showers":wetN===1?"Possible shower":WDESC[code]||"Dry";
    const cclass=rs.some(x=>x.code>=95)?"danger":wetN>=2?"rainWet":"";
    const detail=MODELS.map(md=>{
       const r=b.forecasts.find(x=>x&&x.source.id===md.id);
       if(r)return `<div class="modelRow"><b>${md.label}</b><span>${Math.round(r.temp)}°</span><span>${r.precip.toFixed(1)} mm/h</span><span>${Math.round(r.wind)} / ${Math.round(r.gust)} km/h</span></div>`;
       if(isResultPending(s,md.id))return `<div class="modelRow"><b>${md.label}</b><span>…</span><span>loading…</span><span>…</span></div>`;
       return `<div class="modelRow"><b>${md.label}</b><span>—</span><span>not in range</span><span>—</span></div>`;
    }).join("");
    return `<div class="stop">
      <div class="stopMain">
        <div><div class="stopPlace"><span class="stopName">${b.p.label==="Start"?s.start:b.p.label==="Finish"?s.finish:b.p.label}</span></div><div class="stopMeta">${b.p.km} km · ${b.p.ele} m · ~${rideClock(b.p.ride_h,s,b.p.km)}</div></div>
        <div class="pointWeather">
          <div class="pointCondition">
            <div class="wxIcon" aria-hidden="true">${WICON(code)}</div>
            <div class="conditionText">${cond}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="pointMetrics">
            <div class="pointMetricRow">
              <span class="pointMetricLabel">Temp</span>
              <span class="pointMetricValue">${meanT}°</span>
            </div>
            <div class="pointMetricRow">
              <span class="pointMetricLabel">Rain</span>
              <span class="pointMetricValue ${cclass}">${prob==null?"—":Math.round(prob)+"%"}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="pointMetricRow">
              <span class="pointMetricLabel">Wind</span>
              <span class="pointMetricValue">${wind} km/h</span>
            </div>
            <div class="pointGust">gust ${gust} km/h</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <details><summary>${b.conf.label.replace(" forecast consensus"," consensus")} · show forecast detail</summary><div class="modelGrid">${detail}</div></details>
    </div>`;
 }).join("");
}
function renderDeterministicResults(results,s,token,ensembleState){
 if(token!==renderToken || s!==stage())return {sm:null,error:null};

 const bundles=buildBundlesFromResults(results,s,false);
 const sm=summarize(bundles);
 if(!sm){
   if(anyDeterministicPending(s))return {sm:null,error:null};
   const anySuccess=results.some(x=>x.ok);
   return {sm:null,error:new Error(anySuccess?"Forecast is not yet in range.":"Weather services did not respond.")};
 }

 const consensusBundles=buildBundlesFromResults(results,s,true);
 const consensusSm=summarize(consensusBundles);
 const loadedModels=results.filter(x=>x.ok && x.src.id!=="best").length;

 const ag=document.getElementById("agreement");
 if(loadedModels>=2){
   const headlineConsensus=consensusSm?.overall||sm.overall;
   ag.className="agree "+headlineConsensus;
   ag.textContent=headlineConsensus.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+headlineConsensus.slice(1)+" forecast consensus";
   document.getElementById("explain").textContent=headlineConsensus==="high"?"The main forecasts tell a similar story along the route.":"";
 }else{
   ag.className="agree medium";
   ag.textContent="Loading forecast consensus";
   document.getElementById("explain").textContent="";
 }

 document.getElementById("outlook").textContent=sm.phrase;
 document.getElementById("mTemp").textContent=`${sm.tmin}–${sm.tmax}°`;
 document.getElementById("mSkyIcon").innerHTML=sm.sky.icon;
 document.getElementById("mSkySub").textContent=sm.sky.label;
 document.getElementById("mRain").textContent=sm.rp===null?"—":sm.rp+"%";
 document.getElementById("mRainSub").textContent="forecast probability";

 if(ensembleState.resolved){
   renderEnsembleRisk(ensembleStageRisk(ensembleState.data,s),sm.gmax);
 }else{
   document.getElementById("mWind").textContent="Loading…";
   document.getElementById("mWindSub").textContent="calculating likely wind + gust range";
 }

 renderTimelineFromBundles(bundles,s);
 return {sm,error:null};
}
async function showWeather(s,force,token){
 try{
   const ensembleState={resolved:false,data:null};
   let lastSm=null;
   let lastError=null;

   const sunPromise=fetchSunTimes(s,force)
     .then(data=>{
       if(token!==renderToken || s!==stage())return null;
       if(data)renderSunTimes(data,s);
       return data;
     })
     .catch(()=>null);

   const ensemblePromise=fetchEnsemble(s,force)
     .then(data=>{
       ensembleState.resolved=true;
       ensembleState.data=data;
       if(token!==renderToken || s!==stage())return data;
       if(lastSm)renderEnsembleRisk(ensembleStageRisk(data,s),lastSm.gmax);
       return data;
     })
     .catch(()=>{
       ensembleState.resolved=true;
       ensembleState.data=null;
       if(token!==renderToken || s!==stage())return null;
       if(lastSm)renderEnsembleRisk(null,lastSm.gmax);
       return null;
     });

   const deterministicPromise=fetchAllProgressive(s,force,(results)=>{
     const rendered=renderDeterministicResults(results,s,token,ensembleState);
     if(rendered.sm)lastSm=rendered.sm;
     if(rendered.error)lastError=rendered.error;
   });

   const finalResults=await deterministicPromise;
   if(token!==renderToken || s!==stage())return;

   const finalRendered=renderDeterministicResults(finalResults,s,token,ensembleState);
   if(finalRendered.sm)lastSm=finalRendered.sm;
   if(finalRendered.error)lastError=finalRendered.error;

   await Promise.allSettled([sunPromise,ensemblePromise]);
   if(token!==renderToken || s!==stage())return;

   if(!lastSm){
     throw (lastError || new Error("Forecast not yet available"));
   }
 }catch(e){
   if(token!==renderToken || s!==stage()) return;
   document.getElementById("timeline").innerHTML=`<div class="error">${e.message} Try Refresh if this persists.</div>`;
   document.getElementById("outlook").textContent="Forecast not yet available";
   document.getElementById("explain").textContent="The route remains available; live weather needs internet access and a model horizon that reaches this date.";
   document.getElementById("agreement").className="agree low";document.getElementById("agreement").textContent="NOT IN RANGE";
 }
}
